title.zh: 编排：改名、编组、拍号、速度图，音色可试听
title.en: Arrangement: rename, group, time signature, tempo map — and auditioning a sound

highlights.zh: 轨道头点一下选中、再点一下改名，可放进分组文件夹；拍号可下拉，速度变化能按小节写。
highlights.en: A track header selects on the first press and renames on the second, and can go into a group folder; the time signature is a selector and tempo changes are written per bar.

highlights.zh: 新增「人性化」：选中音符的力度按位置与音高确定性地抖开（同一段永远同一个结果），渐强不再是一条直线。
highlights.en: A new Humanise button spreads the selected notes' velocity from a hash of position and pitch — deterministic, so the same passage always comes out the same — so a crescendo stops being a straight line.

highlights.zh: 自建预置可▷试听，走自己的发声槽，听一遍不会把声音写到任何轨道；放不出来会说原因。
highlights.en: Your own presets audition with ▷ on their own voice slot, so a listen never writes that sound onto a track — and when it cannot sound, it says why.
